stubs.body:
**Start before the fight starts.** Give a ten minute warning at 7, then a two minute one, so the stop is never a surprise.

**Name it, then hold it.** Try: "I know it is hard to stop when it is good. Phone goes on the charger now, and I will sit with you."

**Tonight, one thing:** put the charger outside the bedroom before you start.

actions.text: Bedtime was a fight again. What do I actually say?
